title.zh: 工艺选择：按需求与平台能力选
title.en: Process selection: match requirements and platform capability

subtitle.zh: 器件体区、局部隔离、允许偏置与实现代价
subtitle.en: Device bodies, local isolation, allowed bias and implementation cost

heading.en: Three tasks and the verification chain

body.zh: 常规PMOS体区：采用平台支持的标准N阱，配置正确体接触。局部P阱隔离或受控体偏置：评估深N阱/三阱选项，核对侧向闭合和偏置范围。噪声敏感混合信号模块：联合评估隔离位置、接触护环、供电和布线，再比较完整电路表现。
body.en: Conventional PMOS body: use a supported standard N-well and correct body contacts. Local P-well isolation/controlled body bias: assess DNW/triple-well options and check lateral closure and bias range. Noise-sensitive mixed-signal blocks: jointly assess isolation location, contacts/guard rings, supply and routing, then compare complete-circuit performance.

body.zh: 验证链：PDK器件与规则 → 器件/寄生模型 → 隔离/偏置/护环版图方案 → 器件/耦合/可靠性测试。标准N阱、三阱评估和联合隔离设计都需要规则、模型与硅后验证。
body.en: Verification chain: PDK devices/rules → device/parasitic models → isolation/bias/guard-ring layout → device/coupling/reliability tests. Standard N-well, triple-well and combined isolation all require rules, models and post-silicon verification.

body.zh: N阱与深N阱职责有交集也有差异，先看器件和隔离目标，再看PDK允许实现。在平台及架构选型阶段：明确器件与体区 → 列出隔离及偏置需求 → 核对PDK器件和规则 → 评估寄生/面积/平台代价 → 完成仿真与测试验证。约束为模型及器件支持、允许偏置、目标隔离指标、面积与平台成本。
body.en: N-well and deep N-well roles overlap but differ. Start with device/isolation goals, then permitted PDK implementations. During platform/architecture selection: define devices/bodies → list isolation/bias needs → check PDK devices/rules → evaluate parasitics/area/platform cost → simulate and test. Constraints include model/device support, permitted bias, isolation targets, area and platform cost.

body.zh: DNW可能增加制造或版图代价，收益不足时不能只因名字更“深”就选用，也不能只凭面积判断隔离够用。用目标工作条件下器件电学、耦合测试和可靠性结果校准选择，检查规则与模型是否同时满足。选型约束后续版图、偏置与验证；设计端使用PDK批准结构，工艺端控制掺杂剖面，不能混淆两者可调项。
body.en: DNW can add fabrication/layout cost; do not select it merely because it is “deeper,” or judge isolation adequacy by area alone. Calibrate choices using device electrical, coupling and reliability results at target conditions, checking both rules and models. Selection constrains layout, bias and verification. Designers use PDK-approved structures; process engineers control dopant profiles—these adjustment spaces are distinct.
